'''Mount Tessef Ruins''' was the name given to ruins located in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Around [[3963 BBY]] the ruins were occupied by [[House Rist]] forces led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rak (commander)|Rak]].<ref name="TOR" />
